title: [Perf] Run the fused GDN speculative metadata launch on Turing too
body:
## Purpose

The shared request classification and the one-launch Triton kernel that build the metadata of all linear-attention (GDN) cache groups for native MTP (any draft depth) and for DFlash2 are gated on exactly compute capability 7.0 (current_platform.is_device_capability(70)) in MambaHybridModelState. On a Turing stage the metadata of every group is therefore built one group after the other, with many small launches between two decode steps. This matters when a Turing card runs the speculative GDN path: the first stage of a mixed Volta/Turing pipeline (it starts every decode round) and the Turing pair of a TP2 model.

This PR gates both on the 7.x family of the worker's own device (is_device_capability_family(70), which reads the current device). The grouped small-q metadata of DFlash2 keeps its exact 7.0 gate, it is not touched.

Test changes that come with it:
- The kernel tests (shadow check against the per-group builders) skipped on Turing as SM70-only; they now run on any 7.x device.
- Two route tests in test_gdn_metadata_builder.py build a FakeSelf without the gdn_policy that the layer reads; they fail on main and get the attribute.
- test_mamba_neutral_pp_update_accepts_int32_slot_indices in test_gpu_model_runner_pp.py builds the model state with object.__new__ and lacks the _spec_replay slot that postprocess_state reads; it fails on main and the second commit sets the slot to None.

Not a duplicate: I searched the open PRs of this repository for the gate and for GDN metadata on Turing (nothing), and listed the open PRs that change vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_states/mamba_hybrid.py or tests/v1/attention/test_gdn_metadata_builder.py. Only #903 does; its mamba_hybrid.py hunks add the PLE short-conv metadata provider and do not touch the gates changed here. The same search in the open PRs of vllm-project/vllm shows nothing related.

AI assistance was used for this change. I reviewed every line and ran the tests and measurements below.

## Test Plan

CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<one Tesla V100> python -m pytest tests/v1/attention/test_gdn_metadata_builder.py -q
CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<one Quadro RTX 8000> python -m pytest tests/v1/attention/test_gdn_metadata_builder.py -q
python -m pytest tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_pp.py tests/v1/attention/test_gdn_state_ownership.py tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_config.py -q
pre-commit run --from-ref origin/main --to-ref HEAD

## Path coverage

| Path / provider | Format | Key conditions (shape, TP/EP, graph, capability) | Expected selection / fallback | Evidence (source / static / executed / measured) | Unverified scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fused DFlash2 GDN group metadata (one Triton launch) | GDN hybrid, DFlash2 speculative | verify_fastpath and fused_gdn_metadata on, mamba cache mode none or align, capability 7.x | selected on 7.0 as before and now on 7.5; per-group builders on other devices | executed: kernel tests with shadow check on V100 and RTX 8000; measured: GLM-5.3-Flash PP=5 | other 7.x devices (7.2) not run |
| Shared MTP request classification and fused state rows | GDN hybrid, native MTP | any draft depth, shared_mtp_metadata and fused_mtp_metadata on, mamba cache mode none or align, capability 7.x | same | executed: kernel tests for every MTP depth in both cache modes on V100 and RTX 8000; measured: Qwen3.8-27B TP2 MTP 3 on 2 RTX 8000 | MTP on a mixed Volta/Turing pipeline not measured |
| Grouped small-q metadata of DFlash2 | DFlash2 | capability 7.0 only | unchanged | not touched | not measured on Turing |

## Acceleration and benchmark contract (required for performance changes)

- Default enabled or opt-in: the change only moves the device gate. The DFlash2 path is opt-in per engine through speculative_config.sm70_dflash2 (verify_fastpath, fused_gdn_metadata), both set in the GLM benchmark entry. The MTP path follows the GDN state policy (shared_mtp_metadata, fused_mtp_metadata) as resolved for the engine; the 27B benchmark entry sets VLLM_1CAT_ENABLE_SM70_MTP_DEFAULTS=1.
- Required CLI options and environment switches: GLM-5.3-Flash: --pipeline-parallel-size 5 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --max-num-seqs 1 --max-num-batched-tokens 512, speculative method dflash with 7 speculative tokens and the sm70_dflash2 block above, VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1. Qwen3.8-27B: --tensor-parallel-size 2 --max-num-seqs 3 --max-num-batched-tokens 2048, speculative method mtp with 3 speculative tokens, VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1.
- KV cache dtype used for the benchmark: fp8_e4m3 (GLM-5.3-Flash); default, no option set (Qwen3.8-27B).
- Wheel SHA or source commit: fork build. GLM: reference 5fef3ad60 (tag verified-2026-10-25-glm53-s5), changed 2ae98d460 (tag verified-2026-10-25-glm53-meta), which contains only the DFlash2 gate of this PR. Qwen3.8-27B: reference 1addd22db, changed 806b1b2ee (1addd22db plus both gate changes, tag verified-2026-10-25-q27-meta), all in github.com/Peuqui/1Cat-vLLM. Not measured on 6a143197e.
- PYTHONPATH, source overlays, or external native libraries used: the fork source tree and a patched Triton 3.6 build (sm_70/sm_75 tensor cores) on PYTHONPATH; native libraries built from the fork, identical in reference and changed runs. None of this is part of this PR.
- User-entry route-hit, speed, and output-quality evidence: OpenAI API server entry, A/B/A/B below; the eight greedy answers of the changed runs are identical to the reference answers. Route hit for the 27B: the engine log line "SM70 MTP shared GDN batch metadata fast path enabled." (mamba_hybrid.py) appears in the changed boots and in none of the reference boots of that day.
- Existing kernel/backend registry and capability-rejection reasons: not touched.
- Per-engine configuration and deprecated-variable compatibility: no new or changed setting.
- New/changed environment metadata and generated reference check: none.
- Route snapshot command and intentional changed rows: none (no route table changes, only the device gate of the metadata launch).
- SM70 registered variables / unregistered reads / model-parameter restrictions, before -> after: no change.

## Test Result

GLM-5.3-Flash, PP=5 with DFlash2 (7 draft tokens), first stage (14 layers) on a Quadro RTX 8000, 3 Tesla V100 + 2 Quadro RTX 8000, A/B/A/B through the same server entry in two series, tok/s (higher is better):
- Short decode: reference 36.04, 36.03, 35.98 and 36.02; changed 36.88, 36.87, 36.88, 36.87 and 36.88.
- Decode of the GSM8K sample of our quality set: reference 59.68 and 59.98; changed 60.82, 61.00 and 61.20; acceptance length 5.5109 in all five runs.
- Prefill of the benchmark prompt is 4.24 s to 4.30 s in all runs.
- The eight greedy answers of two changed runs are identical to those of an earlier reference boot of the same entry.

Qwen3.8-27B, TP=2 on 2 Quadro RTX 8000, MTP with 3 draft tokens, A/B/A/B, tok/s (higher is better):
- Short decode: reference 73.93 and 73.77; changed 77.59 and 77.55.
- Decode after a 14k-token prompt: reference 74.48 and 75.12; changed 78.87 and 78.85.
- GSM8K sample (30 questions): decode 94.67 for the reference (one run, the quality request of the first reference run was rejected by the chat template and is missing) and 99.32 and 99.27 for the changed runs; 28 of 30 correct and acceptance length 3.3538 in all three.
- Prefill is 5.59 s to 5.62 s in all runs. The eight greedy answers of the changed runs are identical to the reference answers.

Tests:
- tests/v1/attention/test_gdn_metadata_builder.py with this PR: 116 passed on a Tesla V100 and 116 passed on a Quadro RTX 8000 (no skips).
- The same file on origin/main 6a143197e: Tesla V100 2 failed and 114 passed; Quadro RTX 8000 2 failed, 92 passed and 22 skipped (the SM70-only skips). The two failures are the route tests without gdn_policy.
- tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_pp.py: 11 passed with this PR; on origin/main 1 failed (test_mamba_neutral_pp_update_accepts_int32_slot_indices, AttributeError: 'MambaHybridModelState' object has no attribute '_spec_replay') and 10 passed.
- tests/v1/attention/test_gdn_state_ownership.py and tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_config.py pass. tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector_hma.py was not run to a result: it needs the gated Hugging Face model google/gemma-3-1b-it (403 in my environment).
- pre-commit run --from-ref origin/main --to-ref HEAD: ruff check, ruff format, typos, mypy-3.10 and the other hooks that apply pass. check-layering fails with "vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py: platform coupling 37 -> 39"; this PR does not touch that file, its last change on main is b32072ac9 (#1254). The CI job pre-commit runs on all files and fails on this PR with the same hooks and the same findings as on main (ruff-check, mypy-3.10 to mypy-3.13, check-layering; the latest main run, #1259, is run 40009610580), in files this PR does not touch: vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/gguf_turbomind_moe.py:609 (undefined name tp_slice_packed) and vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py:156-158 (mypy attr-defined).
